Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at the signal eastbound on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was
struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was traveling at a speed consistent with a sudden impact. Driver 1 reported pain in
the neck and was assisted by responding medics on scene. The force of the collision appears consisetnt with the
reported injury, and the damage to the rear bumper, trunk and taillight assembly matches the described impact.
Photographs taken at the scene conifrm the positions of both vehicles and the visible damage. No independent
witnesses were located, though the involved parties and a responding officer confirmed that the Passenger was
seated in the vehicle at the time. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle
was known to either party or noted during the inspection. Driver 2 acknowledged following too closely and was issued
a citation for failure to control speed.
